does: Moves the game camera's target toward its destination: within the camera switch's TargetSnapDistance (50 m) of the current target it lets the camera glide, beyond it hands the move to ecl::CameraSystem::SnapFade (fade to black, cut, fade in).

evidence.says: compares the squared distance between GameCameraBehavior TargetCurrent (+0x48) and TargetDestination (+0x24) with the square of a float of ls::GlobalSwitches (+0x7BC, +0x950 or +0xC78 by the input mode: TargetSnapDistance of the camera switch set), and calls SnapFade when it is greater

called once (from +0x1E15C51) on a switch to a party member 80 m away and on GK.Camera.Focus of a creature 100 m away, each followed by the black screen; a switch at 45 m glides with no fade, one at 52 m fades
